Rū.nhā-102. The word Amu is also Asu in masculine and feminine genders by changing 'm' into 's' because of 'si' vibhatti. It is also 'adum' in neuter gender by 'si' and 'am' Vibhattis. In (masc. and fem.), 'amu' is changed into 'adum' because of 'sa' vibhatti. Another 's' is inserted. Naggahita is elided. Then 'adussa' is formed. From 'adussa', if 'a' is dropped, 'dussa' is formed. See Rū, P,107. Nīti,sutta,158. Nīti, pada,368. Mog,Sya,P_358.] (a) that, that person. (That man, that woman, etc.). (b) that life, afterlife. (c) this life, this present life. See also Amutra.
